theme: Light mode primary with high-contrast Slate & SuriRent Orange accents
design_principles: Asymmetric High-Density Bento Grid layout with hero status spotlight
Instant Payment & Bank OCR Action Hub integrated into primary viewport
Tactile typography hierarchy using Outfit font with tight letter-spacing for headings
Micro-interactions on interactive cards, buttons, copy triggers, and file dropzone
Preserve 100% of functional requirements and data-testid attributes for E2E testing

layout_grid_strategy.mobile: Single column vertical stack (gap-5), touch-friendly targets (h-12 buttons), PWA compliant (390px min width)
layout_grid_strategy.desktop: 12-column Bento Grid system with asymmetric sections
layout_grid_strategy.hero_and_actions_row: Grid of 12 columns: Status Hero (col-span-12 lg:col-span-7) alongside Payment Action & Bank Hub (col-span-12 lg:col-span-5)
layout_grid_strategy.plan_selection_grid: Grid of 1 to 3 columns: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6
layout_grid_strategy.billing_history_grid: Grid of 12 columns: Invoices List (col-span-12 lg:col-span-7) alongside Payments History (col-span-12 lg:col-span-5)

status_hero.container: rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden
status_hero.active_theme: bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 text-white border-slate-800 shadow-xl shadow-slate-950/20
status_hero.trial_theme: bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-500 via-orange-600 to-amber-600 text-white border-orange-400 shadow-xl shadow-orange-500/20
status_hero.features: Status pill badge, plan title with fluid pricing, trial countdown pill widget with glassmorphism backdrop blur, renewal notice banner.

direct_payment_box.container: rounded-3xl p-6 bg-white border-2 border-orange-500/30 shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/5 hover:border-orange-500/60 transition-all

buttons.credit_card: h-12 rounded-2xl bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 active:scale-[0.98] text-white font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20
buttons.ideal: h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#CC0066] hover:bg-[#B0005A] active:scale-[0.98] text-white font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-md shadow-pink-600/20

bank_box_and_ocr.container: rounded-3xl p-6 bg-slate-50/80 border border-slate-200/80 space-y-4
bank_box_and_ocr.copy_button: p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-orange-500 hover:bg-white transition-all
bank_box_and_ocr.ocr_uploader: p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200/80 hover:border-orange-300 transition-all

plan_cards.current_plan: rounded-3xl p-6 border-2 border-orange-500 bg-gradient-to-b from-orange-50/80 via-white to-white shadow-xl shadow-orange-500/10 relative flex flex-col justify-between
plan_cards.available_plan: rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-orange-300 hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex flex-col justify-between

invoices_table.container: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/80 divide-y divide-slate-100 overflow-hidden shadow-sm
invoices_table.row: p-4 sm:p-5 flex items-center gap-4 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors

danger_zone.container: rounded-3xl p-6 bg-rose-50/40 border border-rose-200/70 space-y-3
danger_zone.button: h-11 px-6 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 active:scale-[0.98] text-white font-extrabold text-sm transition-all shadow-sm shadow-rose-600/20
